allowedResources: Practice check: closed-book recommended, but learners may reopen the module pages afterwards to review what they missed.
instructions: Practice mastery check for the Spring Data JPA and API Layers module. 8 multiple-choice questions, about 12 minutes, 15 at most. It is ungraded practice: the bank below is the learner-visible practice set, answer feedback explains every option, and 70% is the self-check bar. The module coding lab covers this module's hands-on objectives; this check covers the predict-and-explain objectives.
